paper_title: Constraining the axion-photon coupling using radio data of the Bullet Cluster
notes: Headline limit is the two-component (cosmic-ray power law + axion decay) 2-sigma upper limit on g_agamma from Table 2, shown as the blue solid line in Fig. 1. The limit is derived per 290 MHz radio sub-band of the Bullet Cluster spectrum (Shimwell et al. 2014), giving six mass bins spanning m_a = 14-32 ueV; emitted as a step function over the bin edges (14,17,20,23,26,29,32 ueV) with Table 2 values, verified against the vector paths of Fig. 1 (step function confirmed, values agree to <5%). The more conservative all-flux-from-decay limit (blue dashed line, 2.3-5.3e-11 GeV^-1) was not chosen since the paper presents the two-component limit as its main result. Limit assumes axions are all of the Bullet Cluster's dark matter (virial mass M = 3.1e15 Msun); it does not depend on the local Milky Way DM density, so no rho_DM rescaling applied. Confidence level: paper quotes limits ruled out at 2 sigma (~95%).
